title: ageratina neriifolia
intro: Ageratina neriifolia, commonly known as Yerba de la Vibora, is a perennial plant native to Mexico and Central America. It is a shrub-like plant belonging to the mint family, Lamiaceae. Ageratina neriifolia has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating gastrointestinal issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
